question: Is the existing green CI and dependency-review coverage enough for this native-preview build-tool bump, or should maintainers require macOS and Windows `tsgo` smoke proof first?
rationale: The patch is mechanically clean, but native optional binaries can fail by platform and only maintainers can set the assurance bar for weekly compiler-preview updates.

options.title: Accept Current CI Coverage
options.body: Merge once maintainers are comfortable that the successful verify, dependency-review, and CodeQL checks are enough for this dev-tool preview bump.

options.title: Request Platform Smoke Proof
options.body: Ask for macOS and Windows `pnpm typecheck` or equivalent `tsgo` output before merge if platform-specific confidence matters.

recommendation.title: Accept Current CI Coverage
recommendation.body: Merge once maintainers are comfortable that the successful verify, dependency-review, and CodeQL checks are enough for this dev-tool preview bump.
